### `doc_partitioning_for_wide_rows` [esql-doc_partitioning_for_wide_rows]
```{applies_to}
serverless: preview
stack: preview 9.7+
```
When enabled, a scan with a costly filter (a terms filter, a wildcard or a range) that reads wide rows, many fields per matching document, is split into finer slices that run on more cores. This can speed up queries whose matches sit in a few segments, but it uses several times more CPU and can be slower when the matches already spread over many segments. Defaults to `false`.

**Type**: `boolean`
